# Dunes Discovery Tourism - Dubai Desert Safari & City Tours
> Licensed UAE Destination Management Company specializing in premium, authentic Dubai Desert Safaris, self-drive 1000cc Dune Buggy rentals, Quad Biking adventures, Dubai & Abu Dhabi City Tours, and luxury Dhow Cruises.

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name**: Dunes Discovery Tourism
- **Website**: https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com
- **Headquarters**: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **License**: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) Licensed Operator
- **Reputation**: 1,200+ 5-Star Verified Guest Reviews on Google & TripAdvisor (Average Rating: 4.9/5.0)
- **Primary Business**: Desert Safari Tours, Off-Road Motorsports, Luxury Cruises, City Sightseeing
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +971 50 245 6056
- **Contact Email**: info@dunesdiscoverytourism.com
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7 Online Booking & Customer Support

## Core Commercial Offerings & Services
- **Evening Desert Safari Dubai**: Standard, Premium & VIP Red Dunes Desert Safari with Dune Bashing, Camel Riding, Sandboarding, Live Shows (Tanoura, Belly Dance, Fire Show), and Gourmet BBQ Dinner. (AED 99 - AED 350 per person)
- **Morning Desert Safari Dubai**: Sunrise Desert Safari in Lahbab Red Dunes with 4x4 Dune Bashing, Sandboarding, Falconry photography, and Camel Rides. (AED 120 - AED 450 per person/car)
- **Overnight Desert Safari Dubai**: Sunset Red Dunes Safari followed by Bedouin Camp Stargazing, Overnight Desert Camping in Deluxe Tents, and Fresh Cooked Breakfast. (AED 350 - AED 850 per person/tent)
- **Desert Safari with Quad Biking Dubai**: Combined Red Dunes Safari with 30-60 Minutes Self-Drive 250cc-400cc Quad Bike ATV Rental. (AED 199 - AED 249 per person)
- **Dune Buggy Rental Dubai**: Self-Drive High-Power 1000cc Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo & Polaris RZR Dune Buggy Rentals in Lahbab Red Dunes with Professional Rally Guides & Full Safety Gear. (AED 599 - AED 1,299 per buggy)
- **Dubai City Sightseeing Tour**: Half-Day & Full-Day Guided City Tour covering Burj Khalifa, Dubai Marina, Atlantis The Palm, Souk Madinat, Dubai Frame, Gold Souk & Spice Souk. (AED 120 - AED 450 per person)
- **Abu Dhabi City Tour from Dubai**: Day Trip to Abu Dhabi visiting Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Louvre Abu Dhabi, Qasr Al Watan, and Corniche. (AED 199 - AED 550 per person)
- **Dhow Cruise & Catamaran Dinner Dubai**: Luxury Marina & Creek Dinner Cruises with 5-Star Buffet, Live Entertainment, and Skyline Views. (AED 150 - AED 350 per person)

## Technical Specifications & Vehicle Fleet
- **Desert Transport Fleet**: Toyota Land Cruiser 300 / Nissan Patrol 5.6L V8 (4x4 Fully Insured Desert Vehicles equipped with Roll Cages & GPS Tracking)
- **Dune Buggy Fleet**: Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo (1000cc Rotax Engine, 172 HP, 2-Seater / 4-Seater) & Polaris RZR XP 1000
- **Quad Bike ATV Fleet**: Yamaha Raptor 700cc & Honda 250cc/400cc Single-Seat ATVs
- **Safety Compliance**: Helmets, Goggles, Harness Belts, First Aid Kits, Professional Escort Drivers, and Pre-Ride Rally Briefing included on all self-drive tours.
